content.user_title: Prepare Website Metadata for AI Agents
content.value_statement: Websites often lack consistent metadata for AI browsing and shopping agents. This guide outlines structured data, discovery files, and readiness checks for developer-led implementation.
actual_capabilities: Outlines extraction of product details, pricing, and business identity from HTML using Microdata and heuristic fallbacks.
Identifies Organization and Product JSON-LD as target structured data outputs.
Describes product feeds, discovery metadata, and llms.txt as planned website deliverables.
Defines readiness review areas covering structured data, machine-readable pricing, and checkout discoverability.
Provides a local website request example and a sample readiness report.
limitations: Only SKILL.md is included; the referenced Python scripts, extension source, and templates are absent.
SSRF protection, deterministic generation, and schema validation claims cannot be verified from this package.
The guide does not deploy files; heuristic extraction may need manual cleanup.
The guide provides no implemented scoring rubric and cannot guarantee readiness scores or adoption of emerging discovery formats.

use_cases.title: Review Storefront Product Metadata
use_cases.description: Use the documented checklist to identify missing product prices, availability, and business details before implementing structured data.

use_cases.title: Plan Client Website Deliverables
use_cases.description: Prepare a scope covering JSON-LD, product feeds, discovery metadata, and a readiness review without assuming bundled automation.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Staging Review
use_cases.description: Organize a review of local HTML and list metadata gaps before the website goes live.

prompt_templates.title: Understand the Deliverables
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the website metadata deliverables described in this guide. Separate documented guidance from automation that is not included.

prompt_templates.title: Review Provided Product HTML
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this supplied product HTML: [HTML]. Identify available business details, pricing, and availability. List missing fields without inventing values.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Local Website Metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the authorized local website folder [folder]. Propose Organization and Product metadata, a product feed, and discovery files. Identify assumptions and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Secure Conversion Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan conversion for [authorized website] using this guide. Define extraction boundaries, SSRF safeguards, schema checks, and acceptance criteria. Do not assume missing scripts exist.

output_examples.input: Review a product page containing a name and price but no stock status.
output: Available fields: product name and displayed price.
Recommendation: confirm missing details with the catalog owner before publishing Product offer metadata.

output_examples.input: Plan agent-readable metadata for a local storefront.
output: Planned deliverables: Organization and Product JSON-LD, a product feed, discovery metadata, and a readiness report.
Implementation dependency: the referenced extraction and generation scripts are not included.
Release checks: verify product facts, validate structured data, and confirm which discovery formats target consumers support.

best_practices: Use authorized website content and confirm product facts before generating public metadata.
Validate structured data independently and review heuristic extraction results before deployment.
Verify required tooling and network safeguards before implementing the documented workflow.
anti_patterns: Assuming the documentation includes a working Python pipeline or verified SSRF protection.
Inventing prices, availability, or business details to fill metadata gaps.
Treating llms.txt or agent.json as universally supported standards or access controls.

faq.question: Does this package include executable conversion scripts?
faq.answer: No. It contains SKILL.md only. The guide explicitly states that scripts, extension source, and templates are not included.

faq.question: Which outputs does the guide describe?
faq.answer: It describes Organization and Product JSON-LD, product feeds, discovery metadata, llms.txt, and a technical readiness report.

faq.question: Can I review a local website?
faq.answer: The guide includes a local website example. Actual extraction requires separate tooling or agent capabilities and access to the authorized files.

faq.question: What environment does the guide specify?
faq.answer: It lists Python 3.11 or later for the referenced pipeline. That pipeline is not included in this package.

faq.question: Does the skill deploy metadata automatically?
faq.answer: No. The guide states that deployment is manual. Review and validate generated files before publishing them.

faq.question: Are readiness scores and SSRF safeguards verified?
faq.answer: No. The package lacks implementation evidence for these claims. Discovery compatibility also depends on the consuming agent.
